title: Meeting Rooms
description:
# Meeting Rooms

Given an array of meeting time `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [starti, endi]`, determine if a person could attend all meetings.

## Example 1:

**Input:** intervals = [[0,30],[5,10],[15,20]]
**Output:** false

## Example 2:

**Input:** intervals = [[7,10],[2,4]]
**Output:** true

## Constraints:

*   `0 <= intervals.length <= 10^4`
*   `intervals[i].length == 2`
*   `0 <= starti < endi <= 10^6`

solutions.name: Sort and Check
solutions.description: Sort intervals by start time. Check if any adjacent intervals overlap (previous end > current start).

solutions.name: Brute Force Pairwise Check
solutions.description: Check every pair of intervals for overlap. If any pair overlaps, return false. No sorting needed.
